echo.title: Abraham and Isaac

elements.label: God tested Abraham
Abraham was told to offer his son Isaac
They went to the land of Moriah with wood and fire
Isaac asked where the lamb was
Abraham bound Isaac and laid him on the altar
The angel stopped him and a ram was provided

echo.heart: What does God's provision in Genesis 22 teach you about trusting him with what you hold most dear?
echo.mission: Pray this week about one thing you find hard to give to God, and tell a friend you are praying for it.

echo.title: The burning bush

elements.label: Moses was tending his father-in-law's sheep at Horeb
A bush burned but was not consumed
God called Moses by name
God had seen the affliction of his people
God sent Moses to Pharaoh to bring the people out

echo.heart: When has God called you to a task you felt unready for?
echo.mission: Write down one thing God has asked you to do, and take one step towards it this week.

echo.title: The walls of Jericho

elements.label: Jericho was shut up because of the Israelites
God told Joshua to march around the city
Seven priests carried trumpets of rams' horns
On the seventh day they marched seven times
The people shouted and the walls fell down

echo.heart: Where do you need to trust God's way of doing things, even when it seems strange?
echo.mission: Do one act of obedience this week that you have been putting off.

echo.title: Deborah and Barak

elements.label: Deborah judged Israel under a palm tree
Deborah sent for Barak to fight Sisera
Sisera had nine hundred chariots of iron
Barak went to battle with Deborah
The LORD routed Sisera and his army

echo.heart: Who in your life has been a source of courage when you needed it?
echo.mission: Encourage someone this week who feels weak or afraid.

echo.title: Ruth's loyalty

elements.label: Orpah kissed Naomi and went back
Ruth clung to Naomi
Ruth said where you go I will go
Ruth's people would be her people and her God her God
Naomi saw Ruth was determined and stopped speaking

echo.heart: What loyalty has God asked you to show to someone in your family or church?
echo.mission: Spend a practical hour this week helping someone who depends on you.

echo.title: Samuel's call

elements.label: Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli
The word of the LORD was rare in those days
The LORD called Samuel
Samuel thought Eli was calling him
Samuel answered: speak, for thy servant heareth

echo.heart: What helps you to listen for God's voice in your everyday life?
echo.mission: Set aside ten minutes each day this week to listen to God in silence or in Scripture.

echo.title: Nathan and David

elements.label: The LORD sent Nathan to David
A rich man took a poor man's only ewe lamb
David was very angry with the rich man
Nathan said: Thou art the man
David confessed: I have sinned against the LORD

echo.heart: When has someone spoken truth to you that you needed to hear?
echo.mission: Ask a trusted friend this week to speak honestly with you about one area of your life.

echo.title: Solomon asks for wisdom

elements.label: God appeared to Solomon in a dream
Solomon asked for an understanding heart
God was pleased with the request
God gave him wisdom and also riches and honour
God promised long life if he walked in his ways

echo.heart: What would you ask God for if he said, ask what I shall give thee?
echo.mission: Pray this week for wisdom in one decision you face, and read James 1:5 with a friend.

echo.title: The LORD is my shepherd

elements.label: The LORD is my shepherd
I shall not want
He makes me lie down in green pastures
He leads me beside still waters
Even in the valley of the shadow of death I fear no evil
Goodness and mercy shall follow me

echo.heart: Which line of Psalm 23 comforts you most today, and why?
echo.mission: Learn Psalm 23 this month, and say it to someone who needs comfort.

echo.title: Isaiah's vision

elements.label: Isaiah saw the Lord high and lifted up
Seraphims with six wings stood above
They cried holy, holy, holy
Isaiah said he was a man of unclean lips
A live coal from the altar touched his mouth
Isaiah answered: here am I, send me

echo.heart: What would it mean for you to say, here am I, send me, to God?
echo.mission: Tell God this week that you are willing to go wherever he sends you, and act on one opportunity.

echo.title: The Beatitudes

elements.label: Jesus went up into a mountain and taught
Blessed are the poor in spirit
Blessed are the meek
Blessed are they that mourn
Blessed are the merciful
Blessed are the peacemakers

echo.heart: Which beatitude challenges you most, and why?
echo.mission: Do one act of mercy or peacemaking this week for someone who has hurt you or who is in need.

echo.title: Jesus calms the storm

elements.label: The disciples were in a boat
A great storm of wind arose
Jesus was asleep on a pillow
The disciples woke him, saying they were perishing
Jesus rebuked the wind and said peace, be still
There was a great calm

echo.heart: What storm in your life do you need to bring to Jesus?
echo.mission: Tell one friend about a storm you have brought to Jesus, and pray for their storm this week.

echo.title: Jesus and the woman at the well

elements.label: Jesus sat by Jacob's well
He asked the woman for a drink of water
The woman was surprised that a Jew spoke to her
Jesus spoke of living water
Whoever drinks will never thirst again

echo.heart: What does it mean to you that Jesus offers living water?
echo.mission: Thank Jesus each day this week for one way his grace has refreshed you.

echo.title: Saul's conversion

elements.label: Saul breathed out threatenings and slaughter
A light from heaven shone round him
He fell to the ground and heard a voice: Saul, Saul
He was blind for three days
Ananias was sent to him
Something like scales fell from his eyes

echo.heart: Where has God changed your direction, as he changed Saul's?
echo.mission: Share the story of how God changed your life with one person this week.

echo.title: More than conquerors

elements.label: All things work together for good for those who love God
Those called according to his purpose
Nothing can separate us from the love of Christ
Tribulation, distress, famine and sword are listed
Neither death nor life can separate us
We are more than conquerors

echo.heart: Which promise in Romans 8 do you most need to hear today?
echo.mission: Memorise Romans 8:38-39 this week, and recite it when you feel afraid.

echo.title: A new heaven and a new earth

elements.label: John saw a new heaven and a new earth
The holy city, new Jerusalem, came down from God
God will dwell with his people
God will wipe away every tear
There will be no more death, sorrow or crying

echo.heart: What hope from Revelation 21 helps you face a hard season?
echo.mission: Encourage someone who is grieving this week with the promise of Revelation 21:4.

echo.title: The spies bring back a report

elements.label: The spies returned after forty days
They carried a cluster of grapes on a pole
The land flowed with milk and honey
The people there were giants, and the spies felt like grasshoppers
Caleb said they should go up and take the land

echo.heart: When fear makes you feel small, what truth about God helps you stand firm?
echo.mission: Speak one promise of God over a fear you have this week, and tell someone about it.

echo.title: The Shema

elements.label: Hear, O Israel: the LORD our God is one LORD
Love the LORD with all your heart, soul and strength
These words are to be on your heart
Teach them diligently to your children
Talk of them when you sit, walk, lie down and rise
Write them on your doorposts and gates

echo.heart: How can your home become a place where God's words are spoken and lived?
echo.mission: Talk about one thing you have learned from the Bible with your family or a friend this week.

echo.title: Esther's courage

elements.label: Mordecai told Esther about the plot against the Jews
Mordecai asked whether she came to the kingdom for such a time
Esther asked all the Jews to fast for three days
Esther decided to go in to the king
She said: if I perish, I perish

echo.heart: Where might God have placed you for such a time as this?
echo.mission: Pray this week for courage in one situation where you need to speak up for someone.

echo.title: The fiery furnace

elements.label: Three friends refused to bow down to the golden image
The king threatened them with a burning fiery furnace
They said God was able to deliver them
A fourth figure, like the Son of God, walked with them in the fire
They came out, and the fire had no power over them

echo.heart: What would it mean to you to trust God even if he does not rescue you in the way you expect?
echo.mission: Stand firm this week in one small matter of faith, and tell a friend how God helped you.

echo.title: Nineveh repents

elements.label: God told Jonah a second time to go to Nineveh
Jonah preached: yet forty days and Nineveh will be overthrown
The people of Nineveh believed God
The king covered himself with sackcloth and sat in ashes
God saw their works and relented of the evil

echo.heart: What does God's mercy towards Nineveh teach you about his heart for people you find hard to love?
echo.mission: Pray this week for someone you find difficult, and ask God to show you his mercy towards them.

echo.title: Job's response to loss

elements.label: Job tore his robe and shaved his head
He fell down and worshipped
The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away
Blessed be the name of the LORD
In all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrong

echo.heart: How do you respond to God when life brings loss you did not expect?
echo.mission: Visit or call someone who is grieving this week, and simply listen.

echo.title: Trust in the LORD

elements.label: Trust in the LORD with all your heart
Do not lean on your own understanding
In all your ways acknowledge him
He shall direct your paths
Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and depart from evil

echo.heart: Where are you tempted to rely on your own understanding instead of trusting God?
echo.mission: Before one decision this week, ask God for direction in prayer, and write down what you sense.

echo.title: The fruit of the Spirit

elements.label: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy and peace
It also includes patience, kindness and goodness
Faith, meekness and self-control belong to it
Against such there is no law
Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh
If we live by the Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit

echo.heart: Which fruit of the Spirit is growing in you, and which needs more of God's work?
echo.mission: Choose one fruit of the Spirit to practise this week, and tell a friend how you tried.

echo.title: Saved by grace

elements.label: You are saved by grace through faith
This salvation is not of yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not of works, so that no one can boast
We are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works

echo.heart: How does knowing that salvation is a gift change the way you see your own efforts?
echo.mission: Thank God this week for one thing he has given you that you did not earn.

echo.title: Rejoice and do not be anxious

elements.label: Rejoice in the Lord always
Let your gentleness be known to everyone
Be careful for nothing
Make your requests known by prayer and thanksgiving
The peace of God passes all understanding

echo.heart: What worry is God asking you to bring to him in prayer today?
echo.mission: Write down three things you are thankful for each day this week, and pray with thanksgiving.

echo.title: Faith described

elements.label: Faith is the substance of things hoped for
By faith Abel offered a better sacrifice than Cain
Enoch was taken away and did not see death
By faith Noah prepared an ark
Without faith it is impossible to please God
God is a rewarder of those who seek him

echo.heart: What is one thing you are trusting God for that you cannot yet see?
echo.mission: Take one faithful step this week towards something you believe God has asked you to do.

echo.title: Trials and wisdom

elements.label: Count it all joy when you meet trials
The trying of your faith works patience
If you lack wisdom, ask God, who gives liberally
Ask in faith, with no doubting
A double-minded man is unstable in all his ways

echo.heart: What trial is teaching you patience or wisdom right now?
echo.mission: Ask God this week for wisdom about one decision, and share your prayer with a friend.

echo.title: A chosen people

elements.label: You are a chosen generation
You are a royal priesthood
You are a holy nation and a peculiar people
You should show forth the praises of God
You who were not a people are now the people of God

echo.heart: What does it mean to you to be called out of darkness into God's light?
echo.mission: Tell someone this week about God's mercy in your life, using 1 Peter 2:9.

chars.name: Abraham
chars.info: God called Abraham from his country and made promises to him. He trusted God even when asked to offer Isaac.
clues: I left my country and my father's house at God's call.
God changed my name.
I was told that all families of the earth would be blessed through me.
I offered my son on Mount Moriah, and God provided a ram.
Who am I?

chars.name: Jacob
chars.info: Jacob was a twin who later wrestled with God and was renamed Israel.
clues: I was born holding my twin brother's heel.
I bought my brother's birthright for a meal of red stew.
I wrestled with a man at Peniel until daybreak.
God changed my name to Israel.
My twelve sons became the tribes of Israel. Who am I?

chars.name: Joseph
chars.info: Joseph was sold by his brothers, rose to power in Egypt, and forgave his family.
clues: My father gave me a coat of many colours.
My brothers sold me for twenty pieces of silver.
I interpreted dreams in prison and before Pharaoh.
Pharaoh made me ruler over the land of Egypt.
I forgave my brothers and saved my family from famine. Who am I?

chars.name: Joshua
chars.info: Joshua succeeded Moses and led Israel into the Promised Land.
clues: I was Moses' assistant.
I was one of the twelve spies who gave a faithful report.
I led the people across the Jordan River.
The walls of Jericho fell down when we marched.
As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD. Who am I?

chars.name: Rahab
chars.info: Rahab hid the spies in Jericho and was spared when the city fell.
clues: I lived in a house built into the city wall.
I hid two spies on my roof.
I tied a scarlet cord in my window.
My household was spared when Jericho fell. Who am I?

chars.name: Gideon
chars.info: Gideon was called to save Israel from Midian with a small army.
clues: I threshed wheat in a winepress to hide from the Midianites.
I asked God for a sign with a fleece.
I led three hundred men against a great army.
I broke the jars and blew the trumpets. Who am I?

chars.name: Samson
chars.info: Samson was a Nazirite whose strength came from God.
clues: I was a Nazirite, and my hair was never cut.
I killed a lion with my bare hands.
I killed many Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey.
Delilah discovered the secret of my strength.
I pulled down the temple of Dagon. Who am I?

chars.name: Ruth
chars.info: Ruth stayed with Naomi and became the great-grandmother of King David.
clues: I was a Moabite woman.
I stayed with my mother-in-law when my husband died.
I gleaned in the field of Boaz.
I became the great-grandmother of King David. Who am I?

chars.name: Boaz
chars.info: Boaz was a kinsman who showed kindness to Ruth and redeemed the family land.
clues: I was a kinsman of Naomi.
I let a foreign woman glean in my field.
I redeemed the land of Naomi's family.
I married Ruth and became the father of Obed. Who am I?

chars.name: Naomi
chars.info: Naomi left Bethlehem in a famine and returned with Ruth.
clues: I left Bethlehem during a famine.
I went to Moab with my husband and sons.
I asked people to call me Mara, which means bitter.
My daughter-in-law Ruth was better to me than seven sons. Who am I?

chars.name: Samuel
chars.info: Samuel was dedicated to the LORD as a boy and became Israel's prophet.
clues: My mother Hannah dedicated me to the LORD.
As a boy I was called by God in the night.
I anointed Saul as Israel's first king.
I anointed David at Bethlehem. Who am I?

chars.name: Hannah
chars.info: Hannah prayed for a son at Shiloh and gave him back to God.
clues: I prayed for a son in the tabernacle at Shiloh.
Eli thought I was drunk.
I gave my son back to the LORD.
I sang a song of praise. Who am I?

chars.name: David
chars.info: David was anointed as a boy, defeated Goliath, and became king of Israel.
clues: I was the youngest son of Jesse.
I played the harp for King Saul.
I defeated a giant with a sling and a stone.
I wrote many psalms and became king of Israel. Who am I?

chars.name: Saul
chars.info: Saul was Israel's first king, but he disobeyed God and was rejected.
clues: I was the first king of Israel.
I was taller than any of the people.
God rejected me as king.
I died on Mount Gilboa. Who am I?

chars.name: Nathan
chars.info: Nathan was a prophet in David's court who rebuked David's sin.
clues: I was a prophet in King David's court.
I told David a parable about a ewe lamb.
I said to the king: Thou art the man.
I promised that God would build David a house. Who am I?

chars.name: Bathsheba
chars.info: Bathsheba was the wife of Uriah and later the mother of Solomon.
clues: I was the wife of Uriah the Hittite.
King David saw me from his roof.
The son I bore to David died.
My son Solomon became king. Who am I?

chars.name: Absalom
chars.info: Absalom was David's son, who rebelled against his father.
clues: I was a son of King David, known for my fine hair.
I rebelled against my father.
My hair caught in the branches of an oak.
Joab killed me against David's wishes. Who am I?

chars.name: Solomon
chars.info: Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem and was known for his wisdom.
clues: I was David's son, and I became king after him.
I asked God for an understanding heart.
I built the temple in Jerusalem.
The Queen of Sheba visited me. Who am I?

chars.name: Elijah
chars.info: Elijah was a prophet who confronted Ahab and Baal, and was taken up to heaven.
clues: I was a prophet from Tishbe.
Ravens brought me bread and meat by the brook Cherith.
I challenged the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel.
Fire from heaven consumed my sacrifice.
I went up to heaven in a chariot of fire. Who am I?

chars.name: Jezebel
chars.info: Jezebel was the wife of King Ahab and a fierce opponent of God's prophets.
clues: I was the wife of King Ahab.
I plotted to kill the prophet Elijah.
I was thrown down from a window.
Dogs ate me in the field of Jezreel. Who am I?

chars.name: Isaiah
chars.info: Isaiah was a prophet in Judah who saw the LORD in a vision and spoke of a coming child.
clues: I saw the Lord sitting on a high and lifted-up throne.
A live coal from the altar touched my lips.
I said: Here am I; send me.
I prophesied that a child would be born and called Immanuel. Who am I?

chars.name: Hezekiah
chars.info: Hezekiah was a king of Judah who trusted God when Sennacherib threatened Jerusalem.
clues: I was king of Judah.
I prayed when the Assyrians threatened Jerusalem.
God added fifteen years to my life.
I showed the envoys of Babylon all my treasures. Who am I?

chars.name: Andrew
chars.info: Andrew was a fisherman who brought his brother Peter to Jesus and found a boy with loaves and fish.
clues: I was a fisherman with my brother.
I brought my brother Simon to Jesus.
I told Jesus about a boy with five barley loaves and two fish.
Who am I?

chars.name: Simon of Cyrene
chars.info: Simon was made to carry the cross of Jesus. Mark names his sons, Alexander and Rufus.
clues: I was coming in from the country when I was made to carry a cross.
I came from Cyrene in North Africa.
I am the father of Alexander and Rufus. Who am I?

chars.name: John Mark
chars.info: John Mark was a companion of Paul and Barnabas, and wrote the second Gospel.
clues: I was the son of Mary in Jerusalem.
I travelled with Paul and Barnabas.
I left them early in Pamphylia.
Barnabas wanted me to join them again. Who am I?

chars.name: Nicodemus
chars.info: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and ruler who came to Jesus by night.
clues: I was a Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews.
I came to Jesus by night.
I asked how a man can be born when he is old.
I helped to bury Jesus with myrrh and aloes. Who am I?

chars.name: Thomas
chars.info: Thomas was one of the twelve. He doubted until he saw Jesus, and then he confessed him as Lord and God.
clues: I was called Didymus, which means the twin.
I said: Let us also go, that we may die with him.
I doubted until I saw the marks in his hands.
I said: My Lord and my God. Who am I?

chars.name: Lazarus
chars.info: Lazarus was raised from the dead by Jesus after four days in the tomb.
clues: I was the brother of Mary and Martha.
I had been in the tomb for four days.
Jesus called me out of the grave.
I was raised from the dead by Jesus. Who am I?

chars.name: Stephen
chars.info: Stephen was full of faith and the first Christian martyr.
clues: I was full of faith and of the Holy Ghost.
I was chosen to serve tables in the church.
I saw the heavens opened and Jesus standing.
I prayed for those who stoned me. Who am I?

chars.name: Lydia
chars.info: Lydia was a seller of purple cloth from Thyatira who opened her home to Paul.
clues: I was a seller of purple from the city of Thyatira.
I worshipped God by the river.
The Lord opened my heart to listen to Paul.
I invited Paul and his companions to stay in my house. Who am I?

chars.name: Phoebe
chars.info: Phoebe was a deaconess of the church at Cenchreae, commended by Paul to the Romans.
clues: I was a servant of the church at Cenchreae.
Paul asked the Romans to receive me in the Lord.
I helped many, including Paul himself.
Who am I?

chars.name: Priscilla
chars.info: Priscilla and her husband Aquila were tentmakers who taught Apollos and risked their lives for Paul.
clues: I worked as a tentmaker with my husband Aquila.
I helped to explain the way of God more perfectly to Apollos.
I risked my neck for Paul's life.
Who am I?

chars.name: John
chars.info: John was exiled on the island of Patmos, where he received the visions of Revelation.
clues: I was exiled on the island of Patmos.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day.
I heard a voice like a trumpet.
I wrote letters to seven churches. Who am I?

chars.name: Caleb
chars.info: Caleb was one of the spies who trusted God and urged Israel to enter Canaan.
clues: I was one of the twelve spies sent into Canaan.
I said we should go up and take the land.
God said I had followed him fully.
I was given Hebron as my inheritance. Who am I?

chars.name: Mordecai
chars.info: Mordecai raised his cousin Esther and warned her about a plot against the king.
clues: I was a Jew who raised my cousin Esther.
I sat at the king's gate.
I uncovered a plot against the king.
Haman built gallows to hang me. Who am I?

chars.name: Haman
chars.info: Haman was a proud official who plotted to destroy the Jews and was hanged on his own gallows.
clues: I was the chief official of King Ahasuerus.
I was furious because Mordecai would not bow to me.
I built gallows fifty cubits high.
I was hanged on the gallows I had prepared. Who am I?

chars.name: Shadrach
chars.info: Shadrach was one of three friends who refused to bow to the golden image and survived the furnace.
clues: I was once called Hananiah.
I refused to bow down to the golden image.
I walked unharmed in the fiery furnace.
My friends Meshach and Abednego were with me. Who am I?

chars.name: Nebuchadnezzar
chars.info: Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon, who came to honour the God of Daniel.
clues: I was king of Babylon.
I set up a great golden image.
For a time I lived like an animal in the fields.
I came to praise the God of Daniel. Who am I?

chars.name: Jonah
chars.info: Jonah ran from God's call to Nineveh, and later preached there with surprising results.
clues: I was sent to Nineveh, but I ran away.
I boarded a ship to Tarshish.
I was thrown into the sea and swallowed by a great fish.
I preached to Nineveh, and the people repented. Who am I?

chars.name: Job
chars.info: Job was blameless and upright, and remained faithful through great suffering.
clues: I was blameless and upright, and I feared God.
I lost my children, servants and livestock.
My friends came to comfort me.
I said the LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away.
God blessed my latter end. Who am I?

chars.name: Mary
chars.info: Mary was the mother of Jesus, who received the angel's message and said, be it unto me according to thy word.
clues: I was espoused to a man named Joseph.
The angel Gabriel greeted me.
I said: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
I visited my cousin Elisabeth. Who am I?

chars.name: Tychicus
chars.info: Tychicus was a faithful minister who carried Paul's letters to the churches.
clues: I was a beloved brother and a faithful minister.
Paul sent me to the churches.
I carried letters to Ephesus and Colossae.
I helped the believers know how Paul was doing. Who am I?

chars.name: Epaphroditus
chars.info: Epaphroditus brought a gift from Philippi to Paul, and was ill for a time.
clues: I was a fellow soldier of Paul.
I was sent from Philippi with a gift for Paul.
I was ill and nearly died.
God had mercy on me. Who am I?

chars.name: Enoch
chars.info: Enoch walked with God, and was taken away without seeing death.
clues: I walked with God.
I was the father of Methuselah.
By faith I was taken away, and I did not see death.
God had pleased me. Who am I?

chars.name: James
chars.info: James was the brother of Jesus and a leader of the church in Jerusalem.
clues: I was a brother of the Lord.
I was a leader of the church in Jerusalem.
I wrote a letter about faith that shows itself in deeds.
I told the church to ask God for wisdom. Who am I?

chars.name: Abel
chars.info: Abel offered a righteous sacrifice by faith, and his brother Cain killed him.
clues: I was a keeper of sheep.
I brought an offering from the firstborn of my flock.
God accepted my offering by faith.
My brother Cain killed me in the field. Who am I?

chars.name: Noah
chars.info: Noah built an ark by faith and was saved from the flood with his family.
clues: God told me to build an ark.
I was a righteous man in my generation.
I took my family and the animals into the ark.
God set a rainbow as the sign of his covenant. Who am I?

chars.name: James the Just
chars.info: James, the brother of the Lord, led the church in Jerusalem and taught that faith shows itself in works.
clues: I was a brother of the Lord.
I spoke at the council in Jerusalem.
I taught that faith without works is dead.
I wrote a letter to the twelve tribes. Who am I?

chars.name: Elisabeth
chars.info: Elisabeth was the mother of John the Baptist, and was filled with the Holy Ghost when Mary visited.
clues: I was the wife of the priest Zacharias.
I was old and had no children.
I gave birth to a son who prepared the way of the Lord.
When my cousin Mary greeted me, I was filled with the Holy Ghost. Who am I?

chars.name: Aaron
chars.info: Aaron was Moses' brother and became the first high priest of Israel.
clues: I was the brother of Moses.
I spoke for Moses before Pharaoh.
I wore a breastplate with twelve stones over my heart.
I offered sacrifices for the people and for myself. Who am I?

chars.name: Balaam
chars.info: Balaam was a prophet who was asked to curse Israel, but could only bless them.
clues: I was a prophet hired by Balak, king of Moab, to curse Israel.
My donkey spoke to me on the road.
I could only bless Israel, not curse them.
I was later killed in the war against Midian. Who am I?

chars.name: Korah
chars.info: Korah rebelled against Moses and Aaron, and the earth opened and swallowed him.
clues: I led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
I said the whole congregation was holy.
The earth opened and swallowed my household.
I was destroyed for my rebellion. Who am I?

chars.name: Deborah
chars.info: Deborah was a prophetess who judged Israel and sent for Barak to fight Sisera.
clues: I was a prophetess who judged Israel.
I sat under a palm tree between Ramah and Bethel.
I sent for Barak to fight Sisera.
I sang a song of victory after the battle. Who am I?

chars.name: Jephthah
chars.info: Jephthah was a warrior who made a rash vow before battle and judged Israel.
clues: I was a mighty warrior from Gilead.
I made a rash vow to the LORD before battle.
My daughter came out to meet me first.
I judged Israel for six years. Who am I?

chars.name: Ehud
chars.info: Ehud was a left-handed judge who delivered Israel from Moab.
clues: I was a left-handed man from the tribe of Benjamin.
I brought a gift to King Eglon of Moab.
I killed Eglon with a dagger.
The land had rest for eighty years after me. Who am I?

chars.name: Eli
chars.info: Eli was the priest at Shiloh who trained the boy Samuel, but failed to restrain his wicked sons.
clues: I was the priest at Shiloh.
I thought Hannah was drunk when she prayed.
I taught the boy Samuel to listen for God's voice.
My sons were wicked, and I failed to restrain them. Who am I?

chars.name: Jonathan
chars.info: Jonathan was the son of Saul and a close friend of David.
clues: I was the son of King Saul.
I loved David as my own soul.
I shot arrows to warn David away from danger.
I died with my father on Mount Gilboa. Who am I?

chars.name: Goliath
chars.info: Goliath was a Philistine champion whom David defeated with a sling and a stone.
clues: I was a Philistine champion from Gath.
I stood over nine feet tall.
For forty days I challenged the armies of Israel.
I fell to a stone from a sling. Who am I?

chars.name: Abigail
chars.info: Abigail was a wise woman who stopped David from taking revenge, and later became his wife.
clues: I was a wise and beautiful woman.
I was married to Nabal, a foolish man.
I met David and turned him from bloodshed.
I later became David's wife. Who am I?

chars.name: Joab
chars.info: Joab was David's army commander, powerful and often ruthless.
clues: I was the commander of David's army.
I was the son of Zeruiah, David's sister.
I killed Absalom against the king's wishes.
I also killed Abner and Amasa. Who am I?

chars.name: Mephibosheth
chars.info: Mephibosheth was the son of Jonathan, and David showed him kindness for Jonathan's sake.
clues: I was the son of Jonathan.
I was lame in both feet.
King David showed me kindness for Jonathan's sake.
I ate at the king's table. Who am I?

chars.name: Ahab
chars.info: Ahab was king of Israel, married to Jezebel, and opposed by Elijah.
clues: I was king of Israel.
I married Jezebel.
I took the vineyard of Naboth.
I died in battle at Ramoth-gilead. Who am I?

chars.name: Obadiah
chars.info: Obadiah was a faithful steward who hid prophets of the LORD from Jezebel.
clues: I was the governor of King Ahab's house.
I feared the LORD greatly.
I hid one hundred prophets in caves.
I brought Elijah a message from the king. Who am I?

chars.name: Elisha
chars.info: Elisha was the servant of Elijah and carried on his ministry with a double portion of his spirit.
clues: I was the servant of the prophet Elijah.
I asked for a double portion of his spirit.
I made a bitter spring sweet.
Even my bones raised a dead man. Who am I?

chars.name: Naaman
chars.info: Naaman was a Syrian commander who was healed of leprosy after washing in the Jordan.
clues: I was the commander of the army of the king of Syria.
I was a leper.
I was told to wash seven times in the Jordan.
I was healed and said there is no God in all the earth but in Israel. Who am I?

chars.name: Josiah
chars.info: Josiah was a young king of Judah who found the book of the law and restored true worship.
clues: I became king at the age of eight.
I found the book of the law in the temple.
I tore my clothes when I heard the words of the law.
I kept a Passover like none before. Who am I?

chars.name: Jehu
chars.info: Jehu was anointed king of Israel and destroyed the house of Ahab.
clues: A young prophet anointed me king.
I drove my chariot furiously.
I destroyed the house of Ahab.
I was king of Israel. Who am I?

chars.name: Asaph
chars.info: Asaph was a Levite who led music before the ark in David's time.
clues: I was a Levite who led music in David's time.
I was a chief singer before the ark.
Some of the Psalms are ascribed to me.
I played the cymbals in the house of God. Who am I?

chars.name: Jabez
chars.info: Jabez was more honourable than his brothers, and he prayed for God's blessing.
clues: I was more honourable than my brothers.
My name means sorrow or pain.
I prayed that God would bless me indeed.
God granted what I asked. Who am I?

chars.name: Jehoshaphat
chars.info: Jehoshaphat was a king of Judah who sought the LORD and sent singers before the army.
clues: I was king of Judah.
I sought the LORD and removed the high places.
I appointed judges throughout the land.
I sent singers before the army. Who am I?

chars.name: Uzziah
chars.info: Uzziah was a king of Judah who did right for many years, then became proud.
clues: I became king of Judah at the age of sixteen.
I did what was right while I sought God.
I became proud, and was struck with leprosy.
I built towers and fought the Philistines. Who am I?

chars.name: Manasseh
chars.info: Manasseh was a wicked king of Judah who repented in captivity and was restored.
clues: I was a wicked king of Judah for many years.
I built altars to Baal.
I was taken captive to Babylon in chains.
I humbled myself and prayed, and God restored me. Who am I?

chars.name: Ezra
chars.info: Ezra was a priest and scribe who led exiles back to Jerusalem and read the law to the people.
clues: I was a priest and a scribe skilled in the law of Moses.
I led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.
I read the law aloud to the people.
I wept over the sins of the people. Who am I?

chars.name: Zerubbabel
chars.info: Zerubbabel was a governor of Judah who began to rebuild the temple after the exile.
clues: I was a governor of Judah.
I was a descendant of King David.
I began to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.
The LORD promised to make me like a signet ring. Who am I?

chars.name: Nehemiah
chars.info: Nehemiah was a cupbearer who rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem.
clues: I was cupbearer to the king of Persia.
I wept and prayed when I heard the walls of Jerusalem were broken.
I rebuilt the walls in fifty-two days.
I led the people to rebuild the city. Who am I?

chars.name: Herod the Great
chars.info: Herod was king of Judea when Jesus was born. He tried to find and destroy the child.
clues: I was king of Judea when Jesus was born.
I asked the wise men to tell me where the child was.
I ordered the killing of the boys in Bethlehem.
I died soon after. Who am I?

chars.name: Judas Iscariot
chars.info: Judas was one of the twelve who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.
clues: I was one of the twelve disciples.
I kept the money bag.
I betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.
I later hanged myself in remorse. Who am I?

chars.name: James son of Zebedee
chars.info: James was a fisherman and one of the inner three disciples with Peter and John.
clues: I was a fisherman with my brother John.
Jesus called me from my nets.
I was among the inner three with Peter and John.
Herod had me killed with the sword. Who am I?

chars.name: Joseph of Arimathea
chars.info: Joseph was a respected member of the council who buried Jesus in his own tomb.
clues: I was a rich and respected member of the council.
I was waiting for the kingdom of God.
I asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
I laid Jesus in my new tomb. Who am I?

chars.name: Martha
chars.info: Martha was the sister of Mary and Lazarus, and she welcomed Jesus into her home.
clues: I was the sister of Mary and Lazarus.
I welcomed Jesus into my house in Bethany.
I was anxious about much serving.
I said that Jesus was the Christ. Who am I?

chars.name: Herod Antipas
chars.info: Herod Antipas ruled Galilee and had John the Baptist beheaded.
clues: I was ruler of Galilee.
I had John the Baptist beheaded.
I wanted to see Jesus perform a sign.
I mocked Jesus and sent him back to Pilate. Who am I?

chars.name: Caiaphas
chars.info: Caiaphas was the high priest who led the council to decide that Jesus should die.
clues: I was the high priest when Jesus was tried.
I said it was better that one man die for the people.
I questioned Jesus before the council.
I led the council against Jesus. Who am I?

chars.name: Nathanael
chars.info: Nathanael was an honest man from Cana whom Jesus praised before he came to faith.

Jesus said I would see greater things. Who am I?

chars.name: Pontius Pilate
chars.info: Pilate was the Roman governor who questioned Jesus and gave him up to be crucified.
clues: I was the Roman governor of Judea.
I asked Jesus, what is truth?
I washed my hands before the crowd.
I gave Jesus up to be crucified. Who am I?

chars.name: Cornelius
chars.info: Cornelius was a Roman centurion whose household received the Holy Spirit through Peter's preaching.
clues: I was a centurion of the Italian band.
I was a devout man who feared God.
An angel told me to send for Peter.
The Holy Ghost fell on my household. Who am I?

chars.name: Ananias
chars.info: Ananias was a disciple in Damascus who was sent to restore Saul's sight.
clues: I was a disciple in Damascus.
The Lord told me to go to Saul in the street called Straight.
I laid my hands on Saul so he could see.
I baptised Saul. Who am I?

chars.name: Silas
chars.info: Silas was a leader among the believers who travelled with Paul and was imprisoned with him at Philippi.
clues: I was a leader among the brethren in Jerusalem.
I travelled with Paul on his second journey.
I was beaten and put in prison at Philippi.
I sang with Paul at midnight in the prison. Who am I?

chars.name: Apollos
chars.info: Apollos was an eloquent man from Alexandria who was mighty in the Scriptures and helped believers in Corinth.
clues: I was an eloquent man from Alexandria.
I was mighty in the Scriptures.

chars.name: Philip the evangelist
chars.info: Philip was one of the seven chosen to serve, and later an evangelist who explained Isaiah to the Ethiopian.

chars.name: Aquila
chars.info: Aquila was a tentmaker from Pontus, who worked with Paul and risked his life for him.
clues: I was a tentmaker from Pontus.

I was a fellow worker with Paul in Christ.
I risked my own neck for Paul's life. Who am I?

chars.name: Stephanas
chars.info: Stephanas was among the first converts in Achaia, and devoted himself to serving the saints.
clues: I was among the first converts in Achaia.

chars.name: Titus
chars.info: Titus was a partner of Paul who carried a letter to Corinth and brought encouraging news.
clues: I was a partner and fellow helper of Paul.

chars.name: Epaphras
chars.info: Epaphras was a faithful servant from Colossae who laboured in prayer for the churches.
clues: I came from Colossae.
I was a servant of Christ Jesus.

I was a fellow prisoner with Paul. Who am I?

chars.name: Onesimus
chars.info: Onesimus was a slave who ran away and was sent back to Philemon as a brother in Christ.
clues: I was a slave who belonged to Philemon.

I met Paul in prison.
Paul sent me back to my master as a brother. Who am I?

chars.name: Demas
chars.info: Demas was a fellow worker with Paul, but he later loved the present world and left him.
clues: I was once a fellow worker with Paul.
I was with Paul when he wrote to Philemon.
I loved this present world and left Paul.
I went to Thessalonica. Who am I?

chars.name: Timothy
chars.info: Timothy was a young companion of Paul, taught the Scriptures from childhood, and given pastoral charge in Ephesus.

I knew the holy Scriptures from childhood.
Paul called me his own son in the faith.
I was told not to neglect the gift that was in me. Who am I?

chars.name: Eunice
chars.info: Eunice was a Jewish believer, the mother of Timothy, who taught him the Scriptures.
clues: I was a Jewish woman who believed.
My mother Lois shared the same faith.
I taught my son the holy Scriptures.
My son Timothy became a companion of Paul. Who am I?

chars.name: Titus
chars.info: Titus was a Gentile companion of Paul, left in Crete to put the churches in order.

Paul called me his true son in the common faith.
I was a Gentile, and was not forced to be circumcised.
I was sent to lead the churches on Crete. Who am I?

chars.name: Philemon
chars.info: Philemon was a wealthy believer in Colossae, whose house was a meeting place for the church.
clues: I was a believer in Colossae.
My house was a meeting place for the church.
I was asked to receive a runaway slave as a brother.
Paul said he would repay any debt. Who am I?
